ns2:section.sectionText: If you are a degree-seeking student taking a mix of campus-based and online delivered courses during the summer term, you should register for the course section(s) noted as CB. Students enrolling in these sections will be charged the campus range tuition. This is an open enrollment course. Students will be using Elluminate for their synchronous sessions. This section is for students in the Middle School Endorsement program.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC or NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC.
